_calibration_note: Re-authored 2026-08-09 against the artwork, then re-audited against Core Rules Appendix X p.180 which PRINTS this sheet. 'Shiny Bits' is the sheet's shorthand for the p.89 NOTABLE SIGHT (the table whose results include 'Shiny bits: Gain 1 credit') - it is NOT the credits earned, which is what it was first mapped to. 'Encounter Type' is the Encounter Table the opposition came from (Criminal Elements / Hired Muscle / Interested Parties / Roving Threats, pp.94-103); the individual enemy's name belongs in the Enemy Types table's Name/Type column. Of the Enemy Types / Enemy Weapons tables only row 1's Name/Type and Number are addressed -- the app knows WHO was fought and HOW MANY, and a Number with no Name beside it is ambiguous on paper. The per-enemy stat columns (AI/Speed/Combat/Toughness/Panic and the weapon row) stay blank: they are filled in by hand during the battle and no per-enemy stat data exists in the campaign model.
